title: Real-Time CPU-Only Object Detection for Low-Cost Automated Recycling: A Multi-Architecture YOLO Benchmark and System Validation
summary: A fully built reverse vending machine with one camera and one CPU instead of a costly sensor stack. Newer YOLO versions were not faster on this hardware.
keyResult: 131.4 ms per frame · 40% faster than YOLO26 · $1,087 build
